title: Chapter 894
text:
After three rounds of extraction, tiny bolts of Mechanical Force danced on the surface of his body. His entire body felt numb, and his cells underwent subtle changes. In Han Xiao's senses, his cells became easier to control.

Because of his foundation, the upgrade of the two Molding Talents was not difficult and even felt a little comfortable.

Han Xiao exhaled and clenched his fists tightly. The feeling of being filled with strength surged in his body, and his body was filled with vitality.

With the evolution of these two Molding Talents, Han Xiao's self-healing ability had increased by a level. With two Universal Treasures in his hands, there was no harm in having his own flesh. Otherwise, he might end up like EsGod one day.

"With my current self-healing ability, as long as I don't get beaten up by so many Beyond Grade As like EsGod, there shouldn't be any accidents," Han Xiao thought to himself.

His current health and energy recovery efficiency was already very high. Han Xiao had plans for the future. His health limit would continue to increase as he leveled up, so he did not have to pay attention to it. What was left was to continue increasing his energy level. This was related to the attributes of his energy and the efficiency of his health recovery.

In terms of Mechanic abilities, he had to obtain high-level Mechanic talents, learn Ultimate Knowledges, research more blueprints, develop a new generation of machinery, continue to expand the size of his army, and cultivate a mechanical civilization. Although he could take a beating, this was only to ensure the toughness of his body. His main method of combat was still to buy money … cough cough, machinery.

The danger of this encirclement was actually not as great as the Planet Lighthouse battle. On Planet Lighthouse, he was the passive party who was ambushed and was the victim when faced with the encirclement of more Beyond Grade As. This time, he was leading a group of Beyond Grade As to ambush EsGod alone. In comparison, his situation was not as dangerous, and even if the operation failed, his life would not be in danger. Thus, the pressure he faced was much lower than the Planet Lighthouse battle.

The ability extraction interface disappeared. Han Xiao took a look and saw that there was a reward notification for this mission.

Dungeon Spawned: [Fall of EsGod]

Han Xiao's eyelids twitched.

"Woah, the challenge level of this dungeon is probably going to break through the sky!"

EsGod was, after all, one of the final bosses of the Chaotic Evil Faction. Han Xiao had expected that this battle would create a dungeon. However, the players who dared to enter this dungeon would be celebrating!

EsGod had been tormenting the universe for many years and had caused many tragedies. He had always been the most dangerous criminal in the eyes of the galactic residents. Now that the three Universal Civilizations had dealt with this criminal, countless people felt that the security of the universe had been purified to a certain extent.

The three Universal Civilizations had joined hands to do this. In the eyes of many, this operation was a lubricant for the relationship between the three parties. It released a signal to the outside world, hinting that the conflict between the three Universal Civilizations due to the battle of Planet Lighthouse had been resolved, and the galactic environment had returned to stability.

In the joint statement, the three Universal Civilizations announced the details of the operation. The eleven Beyond Grade As who participated in the encirclement were all introduced. They emphasized Han Xiao's contribution, calling Han Xiao the core of the operation and even the initiator of the joint operation. In the end, the achievement of imprisoning EsGod was given to Han Xiao, highlighting his contribution.

Countless people in the universe had heard of EsGod's atrocities. The more famous EsGod was, the more famous Han Xiao would be. This was equivalent to stepping on EsGod to gain his fame.

The recent popularity of the 'Enemy of Ethereal' had yet to subside, and Han Xiao had one more representative deed.

In the universe, this incident was called the 'Fall of EsGod' incident. As the instigator of this incident, Han Xiao had left an even deeper impression in the hearts of the galactic residents.

In the various Star Fields, countless victims who had a strong hatred for EsGod were grateful to Han Xiao from the bottom of their hearts.

…

Planet Shazik Transit Station. This was a neutral planet that provided all kinds of services. It was located in the extremely dangerous desolate universe belt of the Central Galaxy. It was a rare planet transit station that provided smuggling, repair, entertainment, and other services. The target of these services was the wanted criminals of the Fallen Ark.

Only those who were not afraid of death would build a planet transit station in this area. Those who did not have any background would have long been robbed by the various thugs. Shazik had formed a connection with the Fallen Ark and provided them with a high protection fee, thus avoiding the fate of being robbed.

The Lord in charge of this planet was called Shazik, a Calamity Grade Super. He had established a cooperative relationship with many armed thugs, including the Fallen Ark. In the chaotic desolate universe belt of the Central Galaxy, he could be considered a moderate figure.

As for Shazik's origin, it was a secret. The thugs in this area did not know or care and were used to thinking that he was also a wanted criminal of some civilization.

However, Shazik was not a wanted criminal. His home had been destroyed by EsGod, and the once lively planet was only left with corpses and souls. He had a deep-seated hatred for EsGod and chose to become an avenger. He built a transit station in this lawless area and hid like a venomous snake, looking for an opportunity to deal with the Fallen Ark.

The news of EsGod being captured also spread to the desolate universe belt of the Central Galaxy and to Shazik's ears. He gathered his confidants for a secret meeting.

"Once EsGod falls, no one will be able to suppress those lunatics under him. The Fallen Ark will fall apart, and with the fall of our backer, we will also be in trouble. There are too many people who want to rob us," a confidant said.

"Yes, we can't stay here any longer. We have to leave as soon as possible."

"Boss, what do you plan to do?"

Shazik heard this and said with a deep voice, "Bring everything. We will go to the Shattered Star Ring and join the Black Star Corps."

"Why him?"

"I made a promise to God. No matter who gets rid of EsGod, I will be at his disposal." Shazik's expression was firm.

Ever since his home was destroyed, the only meaning left in his life was revenge. However, EsGod was too strong, and his revenge was nowhere in sight. Now, Black Star had accomplished something that he could never do. Even if Black Star was not taking revenge for him, Shazik was still grateful. His gratitude was not limited to his heart. He decided to repay Black Star with actions.

"Would someone of Black Star's level be interested in us?"

"That's why we have to bring a gift."

Shazik lowered his voice. "Over the years, we have bribed many members of the Fallen Ark and sent in many spies. Now is the chance to use them. When the Fallen Ark is in chaos, we can steal a portion of their assets. This will be our capital to join the Black Star Corps."

The eyes of his confidants sparkled. They had been here for many years and understood the Fallen Ark well. They knew that although they were very chaotic, they still had many valuable things, such as the spoils of war that EsGod had accumulated over the years, the secret intelligence that he had collected, the lost technology that he had researched, and the special prisoners that were locked up.

Now that EsGod had fallen, they would definitely not be the only ones who had their eyes on the assets of the Fallen Ark. This was the best time to take advantage of the situation!
